task.title: Repair canonical auto-integrator receipt reconciliation for registry repositories

owned: .orchestrator/multi_repo_registry.py repository scope validation and task_repository_slug_and_default_branch helper
.orchestrator/rewrite/integration_receipt.py frozen_delivery_binding multi-repo resolution, flock/inode lock authority, and malformed receipt rejection
scripts/git/auto_integrator.py thread config to integration_receipt_consumes_candidate and lock_inode binding
.orchestrator/rewrite/test_integration_receipt.py multi-repo receipt, flock authority, and malformed receipt unit tests
scripts/git/test_auto_integrator.py candidate consumption, lock context, and execute-plans regression tests
not_changing: auto-integrator candidate selection or GitHub merge gate
task state store architecture or receipt store schema
second integrator, receipt store, cron, gate, status API, or direct merge path

root_cause_analysis.defect: The sole canonical auto-integrator merged execute-plans PR #747, but receipt reconciliation failed with 'delivery binding no longer matches the revalidated snapshot'. Subsequent re-review identified P1 (missing flock/inode kernel lock verification) and P2 (silent overwrite of malformed/unknown-version receipts).
root_cause_analysis.mechanism:
1) Multi-repo delivery binding: scripts/git/auto_integrator.py passed selected registry repo slug ('ajoe734/execute-plans') to rewrite.integration_receipt, but frozen_delivery_binding hardcoded repo validation to {'pantheon', 'ajoe734/pantheon'}, returning None and causing mismatch rejection.
2) P1 (Lock authority): rewrite/integration_receipt.py checked only file existence, JSON schema/state, and PID, but did not prove an active exclusive flock was held or that lock_path matched the held inode.
3) P2 (Malformed receipt): _apply_receipt_to_state treated parse_integration_receipt failure as absence, silently overwriting unknown-version or malformed receipts on disk.
root_cause_analysis.repair:
1) Multi-repo delivery binding: Extended frozen_delivery_binding and integration_receipt_consumes_candidate to resolve repo slug and default branch via multi_repo_registry.task_repository_slug_and_default_branch with pure predicate semantics.
2) P1 (Flock/inode authority): Implemented _verify_lock_authority to assert exclusive flock is actively held (EACCES/EAGAIN on nonblocking probe), verify lock_path resolves to the same device and inode, verify expected_inode if bound by auto_integrator, and check JSON metadata. Added regressions for unheld and replaced locks.
3) P2 (Malformed receipt rejection): In _apply_receipt_to_state, if raw_existing = task.get(RECEIPT_KEY) is not None and parse_integration_receipt returns None, raise IntegrationReceiptConflictError immediately before mutating flat state or V2 journal. Preserved absent-receipt creation and exact valid replay.
